{"notes": "VISIT 5 (left 7:45). I still haven't seen who placed what. Ratings rest on the picture, what I heard, and private updates. The picture matches visit 4: the whole fish outline is dark and connected. The only pale bits are at the junction (~22.5-24, 8.5-12) and as a curl in the tail loop (~24-28.5, 10.5-12.5). They look disconnected and harmless to the shape. Everyone is hands off until the push.

Omar: His private account now adds that Hana and Sofia did the junction cleanup and Jack did the lower fin. It is consistent with his earlier accounts and the picture. Still strongest on impact and execution. Good judgment holding hands off.

Sofia: Steady coordinator, accurate status, and she's watching for bumps. Omar and Jack both credit her with the junction cleanup, and Jack with the fin joint. Keep collaboration and leadership high, impact strong.

Jack: Upgrading from my earlier view. His private account is specific (built the lower fin, closed the notch, ~137 of 157 connected). Omar independently confirms the lower fin, and the dark lower fin and pale notch bits fit the picture. He was quiet publicly, but he credited others and showed restraint. Raise impact and collaboration to mid. Confirm in the review what he physically placed.

Hana: Mostly quiet this visit ("Agreed, Omar"). Omar and Jack credit her with the junction cleanup, which plausibly explains the stray line being gone, though I didn't see it. Her earlier credit claims are still unverified. Keep impact and leadership low-mid, with a slight lift for the cleanup. In the review, ask what she physically built and who cleared the stray line. The domino totals have varied (165, 170, 157), so ask about that too."}
